title: Figure 10: Jolt Hyperband HPM Source on trailer; Figure 11: Jolt radiated field waveform
description: Black-and-white photograph of the Jolt hyperband HPM source, a large transparent dome mounted on a wheeled trailer inside a building ("Figure 10. Jolt Hyperband HPM Source"). Beside it is a waveform graph of electric field (V/m) against time (sec), captioned "Figure 11. Jolt Radiated Electric Field Waveform at 85 Meters." The text also covers the GEM II HPM source and mesoband sources.
